purpose: Reflect on a class; teach 香港/欧米/アフリカ/わが国/神戸/広島/直前/殆ど

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 地理の授業で、世界の都市を学んでるんだ。
lines.en: In geography, I’m learning world cities.
lines.style: friend opening the topic, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 香港は人口密度が高いんでしょ？
lines.en: Hong Kong has high population density, right?
lines.style: curious friend asking, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: そう。欧米の都市とは構造が違う。
lines.en: Right — its structure differs from Europe/America.
lines.style: friend explaining, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: アフリカの都市も、近代化が進んでるって。
lines.en: African cities are modernizing too, they say.
lines.style: informed friend adding, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: わが国だと、神戸や広島も特色ある街だね。
lines.en: In our country, Kobe and Hiroshima have character too.
lines.style: friend grounding the lesson, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 直前のレポートで、殆ど徹夜だったよ。
lines.en: Doing the report just before due, I pulled an almost-all-nighter.
lines.style: tired friend lamenting, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お疲れさま。世界は広いね。
lines.en: Good work. The world is wide.
lines.style: sympathetic friend closing warmly, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence
